command.newForm.title: Create New Form
command.generateCode.title: Generate Code
config.canvas.fontFamily: Typeface used on the canvas as the LCL default font. If empty, Yu Gothic UI is used when the display language of VS Code is Japanese, and Segoe UI otherwise (the message font of Windows).
config.canvas.gridSize: Spacing (in pixels) of the grid that controls snap to when moved or resized on the canvas. 0 disables snapping.
